_: Fire, v2 (judged beside docs/art/target/04-siege.jpg: tall shaped flames off the roofs, a dark smoke column leaning in the wind, the house left a charred shell). fire.gd reads it. on: the switch (or --fire=v2; --fire=v1 forces the old puffs). Flames: GDQuest's stylized fire shader (MIT) on Kenney's flame tongues (CC0), in three toon bands. A burning house: flames on its roof and at its front, embers, smoke, a scorch, and it chars (roof falling in) as it burns. Which houses stay burnt is the bridge's damage fact (cities[].damage.burnt, bridge/damage.js), never a timer; share_sack/share_razed only pick how many burn when a sack plays before the damage is known. Sizes are in game units (a house is about 0.3 tall). walls: tongues from each burning house's upper walls (fire.gd _alight).
